newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Death toll rises in Russian barracks collapse.
newsitem.headline: Death toll rises in Russian barracks collapse.

text.p: Ceilings collapsed in a dormitory at a military school in western Siberia on Thursday, killing at least six people, injuring dozens and trapping some under rubble, an Emergencies Ministry spokeswoman said.
Rescue teams combing the wrecked building in Tomsk found the bodies of six people. Initial reports said three people died.
"Four people have not been located yet," she said, adding that 42 people had been taken to hospital, and 10 of them were in a very serious condition.
She said earlier two people could be heard from under the rubble, but it was not clear whether they were still responding to rescuers' calls.
Itar-Tass news agency quoted an official working for Tomsk's mayor as saying almost the entire dormitory, which had not been repaired since the early 1950s, collapsed.
About 150 people, most of them cadets, were in the three-storey building of the Tomsk Military Communications School when roofs caved in five minutes before the wake-up call.
A special investigation and rescue team headed by Emergencies Minister Sergei Shoigu has set off for the site.
The spokeswoman said the building had once been a monastery and was converted to a dormitory in the early 1950s. Then a third storey has been constructed on top of two existing ones.
